SavedScenario.title: SavedScenario
SavedScenario.description: User-saved commercial and operational scenario configuration for route profitability simulation.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the analyst who created the scenario

frequencyDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in flight frequency (-50 to +100)

capacityDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in available seat capacity (-40 to +60)

fareDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in average ticket fare (-40 to +60)

fuelPricePerGallon.description: Assumed Jet-A fuel price per gallon in USD

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when scenario was saved

SavedQuery.title: SavedQuery
SavedQuery.description: Custom PostgreSQL analytical query saved by an authenticated analyst.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the analyst

title.description: Title of the analytical SQL query

businessPurpose.description: Business question answered by the query

CostOverride.title: CostOverride
CostOverride.description: User-saved operating cost assumption override for specific aircraft types.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the analyst

aircraftCode.description: Aircraft family code (e.g., B738, A321, E175)

fuelGallonsPerBlockHour.description: Assumed fuel burn in gallons per block hour

crewCostPerBlockHour.description: Direct flight and cabin crew cost per block hour in USD

maintenanceCostPerBlockHour.description: Direct maintenance reserve and line cost per block hour in USD

delayCostPerMinute.description: Estimated direct tactical cost per arrival delay minute in USD

/saved_scenarios/{scenarioId}.description: Stores analyst-saved commercial & operational scenario simulations

/saved_queries/{queryId}.description: Stores custom PostgreSQL analytical queries authored by analysts

/cost_overrides/{overrideId}.description: Stores user-defined direct operating cost assumption overrides
